scanNote:
GRAMMAR 55-BET. Unit 12 — Edinburgdan xat, jadval va 1-12-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 10-mashq (xatdagi 10 ta fe'l), 11-mashq (jadvaldan 12 ta gap), 12-mashq (15 ta variant) — jami 37 ta javob.

⚠ 11-MAShQ — OXIRGI QATOR TESKARI:
  Uch qatorda tartib bir xil: flats ✓ → houses ✓✓ → castles ✓✓✓.
  Lekin 'comfortable' qatorida TESKARI: castles ✓ → houses ✓✓ → flats ✓✓✓.
  ⚠ Ya'ni 'Flats are THE MOST COMFORTABLE of all', qal'alar esa eng noqulay.
  ⚠ Bu — mashqning tuzog'i: uch qatorni bir xil yozib kelib, to'rtinchisida ham avtomatik davom ettirish oson. Bizda alohida belgilangan.

⚠ BELGILARNING MA'NOSI: ✓ = oddiy shakl; ✓✓ = qiyosiy daraja + THAN; ✓✓✓ = orttirma daraja + OF ALL.

⚠ 10-MAShQ — XATDAGI ZAMONLAR ARALASh:
  'last week', 'yesterday' → Past Simple (left, travelled, visited, went)
  'now', vaqtinchalik holat → Present Continuous (are staying)
  umumiy haqiqat, doimiy holat → Present Simple (say, sell, love, serve, rains)
  ⚠ 4-band nozik: 'We ARE STAYING in a hotel' — mehmonxonada turish VAQTINChALIK, shuning uchun davomli zamon.

⚠ 12-MAShQ 11 va 12-BAND — SANALADIGAN/SANALMAYDIGAN:
  'HOW MANY tomatoes' — pomidor sanaladi
  'SOME spaghetti'    — spagetti sanalmaydi ('a spaghetti' yoki 'how many spaghetti' XATO)

⚠ JOY NOMLARI TO'G'RI YOZILGAN: 'Holyroodhouse' (Edinburgdagi qirollik saroyi), 'The Royal Mile' (qal'adan saroyga boradigan asosiy ko'cha), 'PRINCES Street' — DIQQAT: bu 'Princess' EMAS, 'Princes' (shahzodalar ko'chasi). Bu nom ko'pincha noto'g'ri yoziladi, kitob to'g'ri bosgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, past simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, past simple yoki present continuous ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
FLORA NING IRENGA YOZGAN XATI.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Dear Irene,

  I'm in Edinburgh now, in Scotland! We 1) LEFT
  London last week and 2) TRAVELLED north. Some
  people 3) SAY Edinburgh is the most beautiful
  city in Britain. Well, it's certainly very clean!

  We 4) ARE STAYING in a small, but comfortable
  hotel in the centre, near the castle. It's quite
  expensive, but much cheaper than hotels in
  London. The people here are friendlier and more
  helpful, too.

  There are many interesting places to visit and a
  lot of old buildings. We 5) VISITED the castle
  and Holyroodhouse last week. Yesterday, we
  6) WENT to Edinburgh zoo and did some shopping.

  The Royal Mile has lots of souvenir shops that
  7) SELL traditional Scottish souvenirs and there
  are big department stores on Princes Street, too.

  I really 8) LOVE the food here! There are very
  cosy cafes everywhere that 9) SERVE delicious
  cakes and hot soups. The only problem is the
  weather. It is very cold and it 10) RAINS a lot.

  See you soon,
  Flora


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Iren,

  Men hozir Shotlandiyaning Edinburg shahridaman!
  Biz o'tgan hafta Londonni tark etdik va shimolga
  yo'l oldik. Ba'zi odamlar Edinburgni Britaniyadagi
  eng go'zal shahar deyishadi. Ha, u albatta juda
  toza!

  Biz markazda, qal'a yonidagi kichkina, lekin
  qulay mehmonxonada turibmiz. U ancha qimmat,
  lekin Londondagi mehmonxonalardan ancha arzonroq.
  Bu yerdagi odamlar ham do'stonaroq va
  yordamchiroq.

  Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar va ko'plab eski
  binolar bor. O'tgan hafta biz qal'aga va
  Holirudhausga bordik. Kecha esa Edinburg
  hayvonot bog'iga borib, biroz xarid qildik.

  Royal Mile ko'chasida an'anaviy shotland
  esdaliklarini sotadigan ko'plab sovg'a do'konlari
  bor, Prinses ko'chasida esa katta savdo
  markazlari ham bor.

  Bu yerdagi ovqat menga juda yoqadi! Hamma joyda
  mazali tortlar va issiq sho'rvalar beradigan juda
  shinam kafelar bor. Yagona muammo — ob-havo.
  Juda sovuq va tez-tez yomg'ir yog'adi.

  Tez orada ko'rishguncha,
  Flora


UCh ZAMON — QANDAY TANLANADI:

  PAST SIMPLE — TUGAGAN o'tgan voqea
     Belgisi: last week, yesterday
     Bandlar: 1, 2, 5, 6

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan
     yoki VAQTINChA holat
     Belgisi: 'now', ta'til davomida
     Band: 4

  PRESENT SIMPLE — DOIMIY haqiqat, odat yoki
     his-tuyg'u
     Bandlar: 3, 7, 8, 9, 10


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  4-BAND — 'We ...... (stay) in a hotel'
     Flora ta'tilda va HOZIR o'sha mehmonxonada
     turibdi → VAQTINChA holat →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS: 'ARE STAYING'.
     Xatning boshida 'I'M IN Edinburgh NOW' —
     bu ham hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

  7 va 9-BANDLAR — 'that' bilan boshlangan qism
     'shops THAT ...... (sell) souvenirs'
     'cafes THAT ...... (serve) cakes'
     Bu do'kon va kafelarning DOIMIY xususiyati →
     PRESENT SIMPLE.
     'shops' va 'cafes' KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q:
     SELL, SERVE.

  8-BAND — 'I really ...... (love) the food'
     'love' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS OLMAYDI.
     'I am loving' XATO → 'I LOVE'.

  10-BAND — 'it ...... (rain) A LOT'
     'a lot' = tez-tez → DOIMIY holat →
     PRESENT SIMPLE: 'it RAINS'.
     'it' BIRLIK → '-S' qo'shiladi.
     DIQQAT: 'it is raining' bo'lsa —
     hozir yog'ayotgan bo'lardi.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  leave → LEFT
  go    → WENT

DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' YOZILIShI:
  Britaniya inglizchasida 'l' IKKILANADI:
     travel → travELLED
  Amerikada: traveled (bitta 'l').
  Kitob britancha — 'travelled'.


XATDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJALAR (Unit 12 mavzusi):
  'the most beautiful city in Britain'  (orttirma)
  'much cheaper than hotels in London'  (much + qiyosiy)
  'The people here are FRIENDLIER and MORE HELPFUL'
                                        (ikki qiyosiy)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to leave (left)     = tark etmoq
  to travel           = sayohat qilmoq
  north               = shimol
  certainly           = albatta
  a castle            = qal'a
  helpful             = yordamchi, ko'makchi
  a zoo               = hayvonot bog'i
  a souvenir          = esdalik sovg'a
  traditional         = an'anaviy
  a department store  = katta savdo markazi
  cosy                = shinam
  to serve            = (ovqat) bermoq, xizmat qilmoq
  a soup              = sho'rva
  the only problem    = yagona muammo

items.textEn: We 1) ............ (leave) London last week ...
items.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'to leave' = tark etmoq.

items.textEn: ... and 2) ............ (travel) north.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan hafta).
travel → TRAVELLED.
DIQQAT: britancha yozilishida 'l' IKKILANADI
('traveled' — amerikacha).
'travel NORTH' — predlog YO'Q.

items.textEn: Some people 3) ............ (say) Edinburgh is the most beautiful city in Britain.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — bu odamlarning DOIMIY fikri,
o'tgan zamondagi bitta voqea emas.
'people' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SAY.
'says' XATO.

items.textEn: We 4) ............ (stay) in a small, but comfortable hotel in the centre.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — VAQTINCHA holat.
Flora ta'tilda va HOZIR o'sha mehmonxonada
turibdi.
Xatning boshida 'I'm in Edinburgh NOW' —
bu ham hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.
'we' → ARE + STAYING.

items.textEn: We 5) ............ (visit) the castle and Holyroodhouse last week.
items.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
visit → VISITED (to'g'ri fe'l).
Holyroodhouse — Edinburgdagi qirollik saroyi.

items.textEn: Yesterday, we 6) ............ (go) to Edinburgh zoo and did some shopping.
items.whyUz:
'Yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: gapda 'DID some shopping' ham bor —
bu ham past simple, tasdiqlaydi.

items.textEn: The Royal Mile has lots of souvenir shops that 7) ............ (sell) traditional Scottish souvenirs.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — do'konlarning DOIMIY
xususiyati.
'shops' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SELL.
'sells' XATO.
'The Royal Mile' — Edinburgdagi mashhur ko'cha.

items.textEn: I really 8) ............ (love) the food here!
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'love' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
OLMAYDI.
'I am loving' XATO.
'I' → '-s' YO'Q: LOVE.

items.textEn: There are very cosy cafes everywhere that 9) ............ (serve) delicious cakes and hot soups.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — kafelarning DOIMIY xususiyati.
'cafes' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SERVE.
7-band bilan bir xil qoida.
'to serve' = (ovqat) bermoq.

items.textEn: It is very cold and it 10) ............ (rain) a lot.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — 'a lot' = tez-tez, DOIMIY
holat.
'it' — BIRLIK → '-S' QO'SHILADI: RAINS.
DIQQAT: 'it is raining' bo'lsa — HOZIR
yog'ayotgan bo'lardi.
Bu yerda esa Edinburgning umumiy ob-havosi
haqida gap.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

 ┌───────────────┬─────────┬──────────┬───────────┐
 │               │  FLATS  │  HOUSES  │  CASTLES  │
 ├───────────────┼─────────┼──────────┼───────────┤
 │ big           │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ expensive     │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ spacious      │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ comfortable   │   ✓✓✓   │   ✓✓     │    ✓      │
 └───────────────┴─────────┴──────────┴───────────┘

BELGILARNING MA'NOSI:
  ✓      →  ODDIY shakl
  ✓✓     →  QIYOSIY daraja + THAN
  ✓✓✓    →  ORTTIRMA daraja + OF ALL


KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (birinchi qator):
  Flats are BIG.
  Houses are BIGGER THAN flats.
  Castles are THE BIGGEST OF all.


BARCHA TO'RT QATOR:

  BIG  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are big.                     (NAMUNA)
     Houses are bigger than flats.      (NAMUNA)
     Castles are the biggest of all.    (NAMUNA)

  EXPENSIVE  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are expensive.
     Houses are more expensive than flats.
     Castles are the most expensive of all.

  SPACIOUS  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are spacious.
     Houses are more spacious than flats.
     Castles are the most spacious of all.

  COMFORTABLE  (castles ✓, houses ✓✓, flats ✓✓✓)
     Castles are comfortable.
     Houses are more comfortable than castles.
     Flats are the most comfortable of all.


DIQQAT — OXIRGI QATOR TESKARI!
  Birinchi uch qatorda:
     flats ✓  <  houses ✓✓  <  castles ✓✓✓
  Oxirgi ('comfortable') qatorda esa:
     castles ✓  <  houses ✓✓  <  flats ✓✓✓

  MANTIQ: qal'alar KATTA, QIMMAT va KENG,
  lekin QULAY EMAS (sovuq, katta, isitish qiyin).
  Kvartiralar esa kichik, lekin ENG QULAY.

  Shuning uchun bu qatorda gaplar QAL'ADAN
  boshlanadi va KVARTIRA bilan tugaydi.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  big         → bigGER / the bigGEST
                (undosh IKKILANADI)
  expensive   → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)
  spacious    → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)
  comfortable → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a flat    = kvartira (Amerikada: apartment)
  a house   = uy
  a castle  = qal'a ('t' O'QILMAYDI)
  spacious  = keng, kengqamrovli

modelSentences.uz: Uylar kvartiralardan kattaroq. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — undosh IKKILANADI)

modelSentences.sentence: Castles are the biggest of all.
modelSentences.uz: Qal'alar hammasidan katta. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — ORTTIRMA + OF ALL)

modelSentences.sentence: Houses are more expensive than flats.
Castles are the most expensive of all.
Houses are more spacious than flats.
Castles are the most spacious of all.

modelSentences.uz: Qal'alar qulay. (DIQQAT: bu qatorda eng past ko'rsatkich QAL'ADA)

modelSentences.sentence: Houses are more comfortable than castles.
Flats are the most comfortable of all.
modelSentences.uz: Kvartiralar hammasidan qulay. (jadvalning oxirgi qatori TESKARI)

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BESh BAND — 1-12 unitlarning UMUMIY
TAKRORI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C  than
   2  A  older
   3  B  in
   4  A  at
   5  A  carefully
   6  C  because
   7  B  Did
   8  A  ago
   9  B  when
  10  A  could
  11  B  How many
  12  C  some
  13  C  at the moment
  14  A  goes
  15  C  How often


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Bizning uyimiz siznikidan kattaroq.
   2  Buvim bobomdan katta.
   3  Dunyodagi eng issiq joy qaysi?
   4  Shanba kechasi xitoy restoranida ovqatlandik.
   5  Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
   6  Derazani yopdim, chunki tashqarida sovuq edi.
   7  O'tgan yozda ta'tilga bordingmi?
   8  Oxirgi marta televizor ko'rganim ikki soat
      oldin edi.
   9  U olti yoshida birinchi marta futbol o'ynadi.
  10  O'n yoshingda chang'i ucha olardingmi?
  11  Pitsa uchun qancha pomidor kerak?
  12  Kechki ovqatga biroz spagetti sotib olishimiz
      kerak.
  13  Ular hozir nonushta qilishyapti.
  14  Onam har chorshanba supermarketga boradi.
  15  Oilangiz bilan qanchalik tez-tez sayrga
      chiqasiz?


HAR BIR BAND QAYSI MAVZUNI TEKShIRADI:

   1  QIYOSIY daraja + THAN         (Unit 12)
   2  QIYOSIY daraja shakli         (Unit 12)
   3  ORTTIRMA daraja + IN          (Unit 12)
   4  Predlog: eat AT a restaurant  (Unit 8, 12)
   5  RAVISh (-ly)                  (Unit 11)
   6  Bog'lovchi: BECAUSE (sabab)   (Unit 11)
   7  PAST SIMPLE so'roq: DID       (Unit 9-11)
   8  Vaqt ifodasi: ... AGO         (Unit 9)
   9  Bog'lovchi: WHEN (vaqt)       (Unit 11)
  10  COULD (o'tmishdagi qobiliyat) (Unit 9)
  11  HOW MANY (sanaladigan)        (Unit 8)
  12  SOME (tasdiq gapda)           (Unit 8)
  13  PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi    (Unit 5-6)
  14  PRESENT SIMPLE, 3-shaxs '-s'  (Unit 5)
  15  HOW OFTEN (chastota)          (Unit 5)


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  5-BAND — SIFAT emas, RAVISh:
     'My father always DRIVES very ...... .'
     'drives' — FE'L, uni RAVISh aniqlaydi:
     CAREFULLY ('carefully' = ehtiyotkorlik bilan).
     'careful' — SIFAT, fe'lni aniqlay olmaydi.
     Unit 11 ning asosiy mavzusi.

  10-BAND — O'TGAN zamon:
     'When you WERE ten ...... you ski?'
     'were' — o'tgan zamon → 'CAN' emas, 'COULD'.
     'couldn't' ham o'tgan, lekin savol shakli
     'Could you ski?' bo'lishi kerak
     (inkor savol mantiqan mos emas).

  11 va 12-BANDLAR — SANALADIGAN / SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) →
        HOW MANY
     'spaghetti' — SANALMAYDIGAN →
        'a' MUMKIN EMAS, 'any' so'roq/inkorda,
        tasdiq gapda → SOME

  13 va 14-BANDLAR — ZAMON BELGISI:
     'They ARE HAVING breakfast ......'
        present continuous → 'AT THE MOMENT'
        ('yesterday' — o'tgan, 'every day' —
         present simple bilan keladi)
     'My mother ...... every Wednesday.'
        'every Wednesday' → present simple,
        'my mother' BIRLIK → GOES ('-es')

  15-BAND — 'HOW OFTEN':
     'do you go out with your family?' —
     javob 'twice a week' kabi CHASTOTA bo'ladi →
     'HOW OFTEN' (qanchalik tez-tez).
     'How long' — davomiylik,
     'How many' — son.

items.textEn: 1  Our house is bigger ............ yours.
items.whyUz:
C — 'biggER' QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida ishlatiladi.
'yours' = 'your house' o'rniga.

items.textEn: 2  My grandmother is ............ than my grandfather.
items.whyUz:
A — 'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → OLDER.
'the oldest' 'than' bilan KELMAYDI.

items.textEn: 3  Which is the hottest place ............ the world?
items.whyUz:
B — 'the hottEST' ORTTIRMA daraja +
'the world' JOY → IN.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 6-bandi ham
aynan shu savol (javob: Death Valley).

items.textEn: 4  We ate ............ a Chinese restaurant on Saturday night.
items.whyUz:
A — 'eat AT a restaurant' — turg'un birikma.
Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashqda ham shu qoida.
'ate' — 'eat' ning o'tgan shakli.

items.textEn: 5  My father always drives very ............ .
items.uz: Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
items.whyUz:
A — 'drives' FE'L, uni RAVISH aniqlaydi.
careful (SIFAT) → carefulLY (RAVISH).
'drives careful' XATO.
Unit 11 ning asosiy mavzusi.

items.textEn: 6  I closed the window ............ it was cold outside.
items.uz: Derazani yopdim, chunki tashqarida sovuq edi.
items.whyUz:
C — SABAB ko'rsatilmoqda → BECAUSE.
Nega yopdi? — chunki sovuq edi.
'when' — vaqt, 'but' — qarama-qarshilik.
Unit 11 (Workbook 45-bet) bog'lovchilaridan.

items.textEn: 7  ............ you go on holiday last summer?
items.whyUz:
B — 'LAST summer' → PAST SIMPLE so'roq → DID.
'Do' — hozirgi zamon,
'Don't' — inkor (savol emas).

items.textEn: 8  The last time I watched TV was two hours ............ .
items.uz: Oxirgi marta televizor ko'rganim ikki soat oldin edi.
items.whyUz:
A — 'two hours AGO' = ikki soat oldin.
'ago' vaqt miqdoridan KEYIN turadi.
'before two hours' XATO.
'early' = erta (vaqt miqdori bilan kelmaydi).

items.textEn: 9  He first played football ............ he was six.
items.uz: U olti yoshida birinchi marta futbol o'ynadi.
items.whyUz:
B — VAQT ko'rsatilmoqda → WHEN.
'when he was six' = olti yoshida.
'until' = ... gacha (ma'no mos emas),
'but' — qarama-qarshilik.

items.textEn: 10  When you were ten ............ you ski?
items.whyUz:
A — 'you WERE ten' → O'TGAN zamon →
'can' emas, 'COULD'.
'Could you ski?' = ucha olarmiding?
'couldn't' — inkor (savolda mos emas).
'could' = o'tmishdagi qobiliyat.

items.textEn: 11  ............ tomatoes do you need for the pizza?
items.whyUz:
B — 'tomatoes' SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) →
HOW MANY.
'How much' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan
(how much water).
'How long' — davomiylik.

items.textEn: 12  We need to buy ............ spaghetti for dinner.
items.uz: Kechki ovqatga biroz spagetti sotib olishimiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
C — 'spaghetti' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' MUMKIN EMAS.
TASDIQ gapda → SOME.
'any' so'roq va inkor gaplarda ishlatiladi.
Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') dan.

items.textEn: 13  They are having breakfast ............ .
items.whyUz:
C — 'ARE HAVING' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS →
'AT THE MOMENT' (hozir).
'yesterday' — o'tgan zamon talab qiladi,
'every day' — present simple talab qiladi.

items.textEn: 14  My mother ............ to the supermarket every Wednesday.
items.whyUz:
A — 'every Wednesday' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'my mother' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → '-ES': GOES.
'go' XATO ('-s' yo'q),
'is going' XATO (odat uchun continuous emas).

items.textEn: 15  ............ do you go out with your family?
items.uz: Oilangiz bilan qanchalik tez-tez sayrga chiqasiz?
items.whyUz:
C — javob CHASTOTA bo'ladi ('twice a week',
'every Sunday') → HOW OFTEN.
'How long' — davomiylik ('for two hours'),
'How many' — son (otdan oldin turadi).

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 55-bet — zamon tanlash va 1-12 unitlarning umumiy takrori.

items.derived: How much water? How much is it?
How often do you go out?

items.derivedUz: I closed the window because it was cold.
He played football when he was six.

patterns.formula: We ARE STAYING in ... (VAQTINCHA)   /   We LEFT ... last week (TUGAGAN)
patterns.exampleEn: We are staying in a small hotel. We left London last week.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz kichkina mehmonxonada turibmiz. Biz o'tgan hafta Londonni tark etdik.
patterns.explanationUz:
VAQTINCHA holat → present continuous.
TUGAGAN voqea ('last week') → past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: souvenir shops that sell traditional souvenirs; cafes that serve delicious cakes
patterns.exampleUz: an'anaviy esdaliklarni sotadigan sovg'a do'konlari; mazali tortlar beradigan kafelar
patterns.explanationUz:

patterns.formula: A are [sifat]. B are [QIYOSIY] THAN A. C are THE [ORTTIRMA] OF ALL.
patterns.exampleEn: Flats are big. Houses are bigger than flats. Castles are the biggest of all.
patterns.exampleUz: Kvartiralar katta. Uylar kvartiralardan kattaroq. Qal'alar hammasidan katta.
patterns.explanationUz:
✓ = oddiy, ✓✓ = qiyosiy + THAN,
✓✓✓ = orttirma + OF ALL.

patterns.exampleEn: My father always drives very carefully.
patterns.exampleUz: Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
